newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-NOON RADIO HEADLINES FOR MARCH 19.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-NOON RADIO HEADLINES FOR MARCH 19.

text.p: Here are the main headlines reported on Latvia's state radio in the early afternon on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russia and Latvia have prepared a border agreement text in which Latvia gives up its claim for the formerly Latvian territory of Abrene.
- PM Andris Shkele says much has been done by way of improving bilateral Russian Latvian relations.

- Strategic investors of Latvian Gas from both Germany and Russia will meet in Riga next week to finalize the text of the agreement. The signing of share purchase agreement itself is scheduled for April 2.
